recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-6934; future edits should be driven by later search-escaping issues rather than reapplying the original DSTU1 prose literally.
issue_request: FHIR-6934 was a Published FHIR-I change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked how URI search values should be escaped when comma-delimited OR semantics interact with percent-encoded URI characters, and asked for a NamingSystem note discouraging hard-to-escape system identifier URI characters.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 6534. Migrated commit c1eef260f554e28cdcf75064a00d41627b05e095 ('#6934 - add note about escaping') added ValueSet URL escaping examples to source/search.html and the requested NamingSystem warning to source/namingsystem/namingsystem-spreadsheet.xml; later build refactors carried that warning into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: FHIR-6933 is the same report resolved Not Persuasive with a direction to see FHIR-6934. Later same-section changes, including GF#17464, FHIR-42834, and FHIR-48702, refined the search escaping examples and URL-encoding presentation without reversing the two-layer escaping rule. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/search.html:2734-2805 distinguishes FHIR backslash delimiter escaping from RFC 3986 percent encoding and includes the relevant ValueSet url examples, while source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml:700-704 retains the requested warning for the active NamingSystem resource listed in source/fhir.ini.
